## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Hetuduka, Kusalattika* is a text located in the *Duka-Tika-Paṭṭhāna* (Dyad-Triad) section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Nyanatiloka 2007]. The chapter systematically examines the conditional relations arising from the combination of the Root Dyad (*hetuduka*) and the Wholesome Triad (*kusalattika*) [Nyanatiloka 2007]. In its positive formulas, it investigates permutations such as: dependent on a phenomenon that is a root and wholesome (*hetu kusala*), there arises conditioned by root condition (*hetupaccaya*) or other conditions, a phenomenon that is a root and wholesome, a phenomenon that is not a root but wholesome, or both [Nyanatiloka 2007]. It also applies negative interrogative permutations across these categories, such as the *nahetuduka-kusalattika* matrix [Nyanatiloka 2007].
